source_detail: URI acquisition announcement and FY2024 acquisition footnote
calculation_or_source: Synthesis of official acquisition disclosure
what_it_says: Yak acquisition economics are visible at acquisition level.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not disclose ongoing Matting category margin, OEC, capex, utilization, or ROIC inside URI.

calculation_or_source: Base purchase price disclosed by URI
what_it_says: URI announced an approximately 1.100B USD cash acquisition of Yak.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not the final acquisition-date fair value or full invested-capital measure.

calculation_or_source: Cash plus estimated contingent consideration
what_it_says: The acquisition-date fair value of purchase price to acquire Yak was 1.158B USD.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not the same as OEC or replacement cost of the mat fleet.
next_source: Final purchase accounting and category OEC

calculation_or_source: Estimated contingent consideration included in fair value
what_it_says: URI included 41M USD of estimated contingent consideration in the acquisition fair value.
what_it_does_not_say: The maximum contingent payment could be higher.

calculation_or_source: Maximum revenue-attainment contingent consideration
what_it_says: Maximum contingent consideration was 50M USD based on revenue attainment in the first two years after closing.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose whether the maximum was earned.

calculation_or_source: Yak adjusted revenue for year ended December 31 2023
what_it_says: Yak generated 353M USD of adjusted revenue in 2023.
what_it_does_not_say: It is pre-acquisition Yak adjusted revenue, not ongoing URI Matting revenue.

calculation_or_source: Yak adjusted EBITDA for year ended December 31 2023
what_it_says: Yak generated 171M USD of adjusted EBITDA in 2023.
what_it_does_not_say: It is pre-acquisition adjusted EBITDA and does not prove ongoing URI Matting margin or ROIC.

calculation_or_source: 171M USD adjusted EBITDA / 353M USD adjusted revenue
what_it_says: Yak's 2023 adjusted EBITDA margin was about 48.4% on the disclosed adjusted basis.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not a GAAP gross margin or ongoing URI Matting margin.

calculation_or_source: Approximately 600000 mats
what_it_says: Yak had approximately 600000 hardwood, softwood, and composite mats.
what_it_does_not_say: Approximate mat count does not disclose age, OEC, utilization, or replacement cost.

calculation_or_source: 353M USD adjusted revenue / 600000 mats
what_it_says: Yak generated about 588 USD of adjusted revenue per mat in 2023 using approximate mat count.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not utilization, rate, or revenue per average deployed mat.

calculation_or_source: 171M USD adjusted EBITDA / 600000 mats
what_it_says: Yak generated about 285 USD of adjusted EBITDA per mat in 2023 using approximate mat count.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not ongoing URI EBITDA per mat or ROIC.

calculation_or_source: 1.100B USD base purchase price / 600000 mats
what_it_says: Base purchase price was about 1833 USD per mat using approximate mat count.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not replacement cost or OEC per mat.

source_file: derived from SEC R14 acquisition footnote
calculation_or_source: 1.158B USD acquisition-date fair value / 600000 mats
what_it_says: Acquisition-date fair value was about 1930 USD per mat using approximate mat count.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not replacement cost or category invested capital per mat.

calculation_or_source: Rental equipment acquired
what_it_says: URI allocated 127M USD of fair value to acquired rental equipment.
what_it_does_not_say: Purchase-accounting fair value is not OEC, replacement cost, or ongoing capex need.

metric: Acquired rental-equipment fair value per mat
source_file: derived from SEC R14 acquisition footnote
calculation_or_source: 127M USD acquired rental-equipment fair value / 600000 mats
what_it_says: Purchase accounting implies about 212 USD of acquired rental-equipment fair value per approximate mat.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not original cost, replacement cost, market value by mat type, or capex intensity.

calculation_or_source: Customer relationship intangible assets
what_it_says: URI allocated 150M USD to customer relationships with a 6-year amortization life.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose category customer revenue concentration or retention economics.

calculation_or_source: Goodwill assigned to Specialty segment
what_it_says: URI assigned 828M USD of Yak goodwill to Specialty.
what_it_does_not_say: Goodwill alone does not prove good or poor category economics.

metric: Goodwill share of acquisition-date fair value
source_file: derived from SEC R14 acquisition footnote
calculation_or_source: 828M USD goodwill / 1.158B USD acquisition-date fair value
what_it_says: About 71.5% of acquisition-date fair value was goodwill.
what_it_does_not_say: This is not a return metric and cannot be used alone to judge economics.

calculation_or_source: Net identifiable assets acquired
what_it_says: Net identifiable assets acquired were 330M USD.
what_it_does_not_say: Net identifiable assets are purchase-accounting assets, not category operating invested capital.

metric: Net identifiable asset share of fair value
source_file: derived from SEC R14 acquisition footnote
calculation_or_source: 330M USD net identifiable assets / 1.158B USD acquisition-date fair value
what_it_says: Net identifiable assets were about 28.5% of acquisition-date fair value.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not prove Matting ROIC or capital intensity.

calculation_or_source: Post-acquisition revenue attributable to acquired Yak locations
what_it_says: Yak locations contributed 322M USD of post-acquisition revenue in FY2024.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not full-year post-integration run-rate revenue and does not disclose earnings.

calculation_or_source: 97M USD historic Yak revenue plus 322M USD post-acquisition Yak revenue
what_it_says: Pro forma 2024 revenue includes 419M USD of pre/post-acquisition Yak revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: Pro forma information is not necessarily indicative of future results and does not include cost savings or revenue opportunities.

calculation_or_source: Issuance of 6 1/8 Senior Notes plus ABL drawings funded acquisition and related expenses
what_it_says: URI funded the acquisition and related fees through 1.100B USD of 6 1/8% senior notes and ABL drawings.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose how much of ABL capacity funded any specific asset or mat purchase schedule.
next_source: Debt note and ABL draw detail

value: utility; midstream; power; pipeline; industrial; renewables; infrastructure
calculation_or_source: Yak primarily served utility and midstream/pipeline/power/infrastructure-related customers
what_it_says: Matting connects URI Specialty to utility, midstream, power, renewables, and infrastructure customer demand.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose revenue by customer, project, or end market.

calculation_or_source: Combines official acquisition announcement, purchase accounting, and derived acquisition metrics
what_it_says: Matting has acquisition-level revenue, EBITDA, mat-count, purchase-price, purchase-accounting, and funding evidence.
what_it_does_not_say: Do not promote this to ongoing Matting category margin, OEC, capex, utilization, or ROIC.
